picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the U.S. Air Force successfully flew an AI agent autonomously controlling a modified F-16, a major real-world milestone toward scalable autonomous air combat capability.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's American Science Cloud is a DOE-federated cloud infrastructure unifying data, models, and HPC resources nationwide under the Genesis Mission, a significant government-academic-industry partnership to accelerate AI-driven science.
picks.title: How the Genesis Mission’s American Science Cloud Advances Innovation

picks.editorial_note: A major philanthropic gift from alumnus Parker Petit is funding a new Georgia Tech center dedicated to applying AI across the full spectrum of health innovation, from prediction to treatment.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives Commitment to Launch New AI-Driven Health Innovation Center

picks.editorial_note: UCSF Health's new AI accelerator, backed by venture firms Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital, embeds startups directly in a live academic medical center to co-develop clinical AI tools, a notable model for translating AI research into patient care.
picks.title: UCSF Health Partners to Launch New Model to Build Healthcare AI

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's Whittle Laboratory convened government, industry, and research leaders to chart an AI-driven strategy for reviving UK hardware innovation in aerospace, energy, and defence, signaling significant industrial policy momentum.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University's MoU with NVIDIA and launch of the Chula AI Center marks a significant industry-academia partnership expanding AI research and talent development in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center

picks.editorial_note: Australia's Prime Minister used a University of Sydney address to announce a new national Office of AI and mandatory AI standards, a direct policy intervention with sector-wide implications.
picks.title: Prime Minister delivers AI address at University of Sydney

picks.editorial_note: The National Academies' international workshop on AI-enabled biological threats addresses a critical dual-use risk, shaping how policymakers and researchers approach AI biosecurity preparedness.
picks.title: Strengthening Preparedness Against Novel Biological Threat Agents Enabled Through Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies

picks.editorial_note: A new UC Santa Barbara-LLNL collaboration is using AI to model extreme plasma physics relevant to nuclear fusion, advancing scientific tools for a field with major energy implications.
picks.title: Lab Report: July 17, 2026 | Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

picks.editorial_note: EPFL researchers, working with Swiss rail operator SBB and partners including ETH Zurich and MIT, built an AI model that improves national rail energy-demand forecasting, a concrete real-world infrastructure application.
picks.title: Using future data to better predict Switzerland's rail energy demand
